licenses.hebrewText: Public domain (Westminster Leningrad Codex text as distributed by OSHB)

attribution: Hebrew text and morphology from the Open Scriptures Hebrew Bible Project (https://github.com/openscriptures/morphhb), OSHB version 2.2. Lemma and morphology data licensed under CC BY 4.0.
notes: Display text must be preserved byte-for-byte from the source; OSHB warns against NFC-normalizing its Hebrew. Derived comparison/search keys live in separate fields only.
Do not mix in BHSA/ETCBC annotations (CC BY-NC) or call Tanach.us UXLC text 'WLC'.
Import is development-time only (tools/import_oshb_reader.mjs reads a checkout pinned to this commit); the app ships only the curated generated subset.

strongsPin.license: Public domain — James Strong's 1894 'A Concise Dictionary of the Words in the Hebrew Bible', out of copyright. The Open Scriptures JSON/XML e-text encoding of it (this pinned file) carries its own file-header copyright notice ('Copyright 2010, Open Scriptures. CC-BY-SA.') for the digitization/editing work, distinct from the (public-domain) underlying dictionary text itself.
strongsPin.attribution: Strong's Hebrew Dictionary definitions and headwords from the Open Scriptures Strong's project (https://github.com/openscriptures/strongs), derived from James Strong's 1894 public-domain dictionary.
notes: Added in task 13a for per-token gloss (`gl`) and pointed-headword (`lx`) generation (tools/gen_strongs_glosses.mjs) — dev-time only, never fetched at runtime; the app ships only the short, modernized glosses this pipeline extracts for the exact Strong's numbers appearing in the curated Reader selections.

Archaic English in strongs_def/kjv_def (thee/thou/thy/ye, -eth/-est verb endings, unto/hath/saith/shalt) is mechanically modernized via a documented replacement table — see tools/gen_strongs_glosses.mjs's MODERNIZE_TABLE.
